name: Asane Myuu
source:
One of [url=http://vndb.org/c11686]Miina's[/url] childhood friends. She is distrustful of [url=http://vndb.org/c11693]Yuusaku[/url] and treats him harshly. She is concerned with Miina being with someone she doesn't know very well.

She doesn't do well in school but makes up for it by being very athletic.
